title: Triads in Defence of the Holy Hesychasts
author: Gregory Palamas
edition_cited: Greek ed. J. Meyendorff 1959; English trans. N. Gendle (Classics of Western Spirituality, 1983)

date_evidence.basis: archive.org record for the Paulist Press translation (lending copy only)

summary: Palamas's defence of the hesychasts argues that the saints see the uncreated light with senses transformed by the Spirit, 'beyond sense and mind', and defends the psychophysical method (gaze on the chest/navel, breath restraint) for beginners. No public-domain Greek text or free translation was found on the allowed archives (the Triads are not in Migne PG); only in-copyright editions exist.
why_relevant: Key theoretical statement on the perceptual status of the Taboric light and on the breath/gaze method.
